'''''Pohlia''''' is a genus of mosses in the family [[Mniaceae]], found on all continents including Antarctica. Some of its species are native to multiple continents. The [[center of diversity]] is the Northern Hemisphere.<ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1600/036364406777585694 |title=A Revision of the Moss Genus ''Pohlia'' Hedw. (Mniaceae) in Australia |year=2006 |last1=Shaw |first1=A. Jonathan |s2cid=85078951 |journal=Systematic Botany |volume=31 |issue=2 |pages=247–257 |bibcode=2006SysBo..31..247S }}</ref>

The genus name of ''Pohlia'' is in honour of [[Johann Ehrenfried Pohl]] (1746–1800), who was a German physician and botanist.<ref>{{cite book | last=Burkhardt | first=Lotte | title=Eine Enzyklopädie zu eponymischen Pflanzennamen |trans-title=Encyclopedia of eponymic plant names | publisher=Botanic Garden and Botanical Museum, Freie Universität Berlin | year=2022 | isbn=978-3-946292-41-8 | url=https://doi.org/10.3372/epolist2022|format=pdf |language=German |location=Berlin | doi=10.3372/epolist2022 |access-date=January 27, 2022}}</ref> 

The genus was [[circumscription (taxonomy)|circumscribed]] by [[Johann Hedwig]] in Descriptio et Adumbratio microscopio-analytica Muscorum
Frondosorum vol.1 on page 98 in 1785-1787.
